_doc: Survivor behaviour per skill key (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md section 7, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). Canonical per-level numbers (fixdamage, mad, mastery, attackCount, x, pdd) are NOT here: SkillBook reads them from Skill.wz via setup.skill_imgs[book].skill[<7-digit id>].level[<level>]. ranks is the complete sequence 1..N from the canonical Skill.wz level table: survivor rank r equals canonical level r, and every rank card adds exactly one level. cooldown (s), range (px), speed (px/s), count (projectiles or targets), pierce (extra mobs a shot passes through), radius (shot hit radius, px), action_time (s of the cast stance) are tier C (ours). damage: fixed = canonical fixdamage; magic = GAME_DESIGN 6.1 formula with canonical mad/mastery; none = passive. Visual and sound fields are WZ paths into the asset cache; {level} = canonical level, {cl} = the char_level variant (the highest threshold <= character level). passive.stat/per_level: survivor effect per canonical level (tier C MaxMP percentage reinterpretation). buff.stat/field/duration_field: active effect and canonical duration; Nimble Feet speed feeds movement; Magic Guard x% feeds mp_guard, Magic Armor pdd feeds defense, canonical time gives seconds. level_ranks {character level: rank}: the skill reaches at least that survivor rank at that character level (the SP a v83 Beginner spends on Three Snails; cards can get there sooner).

nimble_feet.name: Nimble Feet
nimble_feet.desc: Temporarily increases movement speed, with a 60 second cooldown.
nimble_feet._buff: Tier A: canonical speed/time/mpCon/cooltime. Tier C: automatically cast when inactive, off cooldown and affordable, never while climbing; no cast stance because the canonical skill has no action node.

recovery.name: Recovery
recovery.desc: Heals HP every 5 seconds for 30 seconds when hurt.
recovery._buff: Tier C: cast below 50% HP; interpret canonical x as HP every 5 s, six pulses including the final pulse at 30 s. Values, duration, MP cost and cooldown stay canonical.

three_snails.name: Three Snails
three_snails.desc: Hurls snail shells at the nearest monster.

energy_bolt.name: Energy Bolt
energy_bolt.desc: Fires a bolt of energy at the nearest monster.

magic_claw.name: Magic Claw
magic_claw.desc: Rakes the nearest monster twice with a magic claw.

magic_guard.name: Magic Guard
magic_guard.desc: Part of the damage you take is paid with MP instead of HP.

magic_armor.name: Magic Armor
magic_armor.desc: Magic hardens your armor: higher weapon defence against touch damage.

improved_max_mp.name: Improved MaxMP Increase
improved_max_mp.desc: Increases computed Max MP by 2% per skill level.
improved_max_mp._passive: Tier C: owner choice; multiply computed Max MP, including level/INT growth and job bonus, by 1 + 0.02 per skill level. Preserve current MP ratio when it grows. Canonical skill instead raises MP gained per level.

improved_mp_recovery.name: Improved MP Recovery
improved_mp_recovery.desc: Adds character-level-scaled MP recovery every 10 seconds.

mp_eater_fp.name: MP Eater
mp_eater_fp.desc: Magic hits may absorb MP from a monster's remaining pool.
mp_eater_fp._passive: Tier A: canonical prop chance, x percent of Mob.wz maxMP, and exhaustion. Tier C: survivor magic-hit listener; absorb truncates to whole MP (integer interpretation).
